ns2:section.sectionText: TOPIC: "Work in Contemporary Latin American Cultural Production." Students must meet the prerequisite requirements for this course (found in the Catalog Entry) or will be told to drop on the first day of classes. Non-registered students are not allowed to sit in or audit. Studies how different forms of cultural production (film, novel, short story, critical essay) represent new settings and conditions for work in Latin America, in four economic sectors: service, finance, manufacturing and the informal economy (particularly drug trafficking).
